items.title: Nifty 50 companies likely to log strong double-digit growth in Q2
items.description: Revenue and net profit of Nifty 50 companies are projected to grow by nearly 20% year-on-year. Analysts note that performance is driven by sectors like automobiles, banking, and oil. Operating margins, however, might contract slightly due to input cost pressures and inflation. Key sectors show varied conditions, balancing strong demand against potential challenges. Overall, medium to long-term outlook remains optimistic, despite some near-term volatility.

items.title: Nifty earnings seen rising 27%, strongest growth in 17 quarters in Q2: Motilal Oswal
items.description: India’s Q2FY27 earnings season is expected to mark a strong recovery in corporate profitability, with Nifty 50 earnings projected to grow 27% YoY, the highest in 17 quarters, according to Motilal Oswal. While resilient domestic fundamentals and liquidity support the outlook, persistent FII outflows, weak foreign investor sentiment and global macroeconomic pressures remain key challenges for Indian equities.

items.title: TCS Q2 Results Preview: Can the IT bellwether show enough growth to calm investors?
items.description: Tata Consultancy Services is scheduled to release its second-quarter results on October 8, with analysts predicting a year-on-year revenue growth of roughly 13%. However, the sequential growth might be modest at around 0.5%-0.6%. Investors will also be looking for updates on new contracts and collaborations with firms like Porsche and BSNL, as market sentiment stays cautious amid ongoing IT sector challenges.
